caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a light-colored, high-buttoned shoe or boot, depicted from a side view facing left. The boot is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with visible shading to indicate folds and contours in the material. Seven round buttons are aligned vertically along the front opening of the boot, and there is visible stitching along the edges and seams. The background is an off-white or light beige neutral color, with no other objects or patterns present, making the boot the singular focus of the composition.
